name: Drive Moris
description: Rent a car at Mauritius airport. Full insurance included, a car waiting at arrivals, and hand-back anywhere on the island. Example prices from Rs 1,400 a day.
address: Plaine Magnien, next to the airport (fictional)

promises.title: Waiting at arrivals
promises.text: Your car is parked outside the terminal. We meet you with the keys, whatever time you land.

promises.title: Full insurance in the price
promises.text: Zero-excess cover is included in every daily rate. No surprises at the desk.

promises.title: Hand back anywhere
promises.text: Leave the car at your hotel, the airport or our Port Louis office. Same price.

extras.label: Prepaid full tank
extras.note: Return it empty, no refuelling stop

terms.a: Zero-excess insurance, unlimited kilometres, 24/7 roadside help and airport pick-up. Taxes are included.
Yes: Rs 10,000, held on your card and released when the car comes back. No cash needed.
Mauritius drives on the left. Every car has automatic or manual listed, and most are automatic.

terms.q: What do I need to rent?
terms.a: A driving licence held for at least a year, a passport and a credit card. Minimum age 21.
Full to full: you get it full and bring it back full. Or prepay a tank and bring it back empty.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pick-up.
